title: Ironhollow Rising Revisited
author: Bram Sterling
blurb: Sebastian Winterbourne, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
